why: No major reviewer (RTINGS, Wirecutter, Tom's Guide etc.) or authority appears at all. Every result is an affiliate site: seven niche pages compare RV-relevant specs (TT-30 outlets, alternator charging, AC runtime estimates) from manufacturer data sheets, several openly admitting no testing, and the rest are thin listicles with no product data in the text. Picks disagree widely (C1000 Gen 2, C2000 Gen 2, Delta 2 Max, AC200L, HomePower 3600 Plus), so there is no settled answer. This matches the solar-kit win: a focused page with current prices, tested codes, and a direct pick by RV size and use would stand out.
